news.title: European Gas Tops 101 Euros for First Time Since 2022
news.summary: Europe’s benchmark natural gas prices have topped 101 euros per megawatt-hour (MWh) for the first time since the 2022 crisis as winter looms amid historically low European gas storage levels. The front-month price at the Dutch Title Transfer Facility (TTF), the benchmark for Europe’s gas trading, surged by 4% as of 9 a.m. in Amsterdam on Friday. analysis.rationale: Heightened Middle East conflict threatening transit through the Strait of Hormuz elevates energy supply disruption risks, while spiking natural gas prices encourages gas-to-oil fuel switching, applying upward pressure on crude oil prices.
